pr_title: [deliver][produce][spaceship] Update to use new App Store Connect API endpoints
pr_body:
Fixes #16639
Fixes https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16649
Fixes https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16653

## Fixes
- [x] deliver completely broken
  - Issue: #16621 
  - PR: #16626
- [x] deliver build processing shouldn't require app version
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16640#discussion_r443233736
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16663
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16648
  - PR: #16713
- [x] Completely new app gets: You must provide a value for the attribute 'usesNonExemptEncryption' with this request 
  - Issue: #16645
  - PR: #16646
- [x] `usesIdfa` - is there a way around?
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16626#issuecomment-647214671
  - Fixes: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16706
- [x] make sure primary category isn't getting cleared out if not being set
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16621#issuecomment-647143129
  - PR: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16652
- [x] produce broken
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16649
- [x] You must provide a value for the attribute 'honorsLimitedAdTracking'
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16621#issuecomment-647241384
  - PR: #16646
- [x] 504 gateway timeout on uploading screenshot (extend timeout???)
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16626#issuecomment-647127031
  - PR: #16667
  - PR: #16676
- [x] produce map previous languages
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16626#issuecomment-647378487
  - PR: #16656
- [x] add `:default` to languages for deliver
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16639#issuecomment-647366971
  - PR: #16657
- [x] category mapping validation (tell user thing was mapped and show link to new doc)
  - Issue: NONE
  - PR: #16652 
- [x] app rating (tell user thing was mapped and show link to new doc)
  - Issue: NONE
  - PR: #16655
- [x] fix `set_changelog`
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16639#issuecomment-647661174
  - PR: #16658
- [x] set "all territories"
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16640#issuecomment-648155512
  - PR: #16656
- [x] set "users" on produce app
- [ ] deprecate `submission_information` for new `idfa`, `content_rights`, and `export_options` options
- [x] app previews
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16640#issuecomment-648289796
  - PR: #16671
- [x] handle multi part file uploads
  - PR: #16684
- [x] set video upload preivew frame
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16640#issuecomment-649762454
  - PR: #16684
- [x] fix mapping for age rating which caused 500
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16639#issuecomment-650186800
- [ ] find replacement for spaceship::sandbox testers
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16640#issuecomment-649961733
- [x] fix issues with iTMSTransporting not starting JVM
  - Issue: #15323
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16639#issuecomment-649805838
  - PR: #16689
- [x] deliver screenshots - don’t uploaded if already uploaded
  - PR - https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16694
- [ ] create bundle id with spaceship connect
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16649#issuecomment-651128619
- [x] fix company name on produce create
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16639#issuecomment-651120161
- [x] Images download with deliver show as wrong image type when re-uploading with deliver
- [ ] add spaceship API to enable B2b
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16640#issuecomment-651961122
- [ ] implement screenshot order
  - Issue: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16708
  - PR: https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16718

issue_context.title: [DELIVER] Support new App Store Connect APIs ✨
issue_context.body:
### Feature Request

#### Motivation Behind Feature

Just in the last few weeks, Apple broke some undocumented APIs that fastlane was using to interact with App Store Connect.  Fastlane should prefer to use documented public APIs where possible to avoid these kinds of situations in the future.

[What's new in App Store Connect](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2020/10651/
)
> We're excited to be adding two powerful new sets of API.  We'll be introducing a suite of app metadata API that will let you manage your presence on the App Store as well as a new power and performance API. They'll let you download the same aggregate data that drives the new power and performance analysis tools in Xcode.  In fact, just between these two new categories of API functionality, **we're adding over 200 new endpoints**.  For app metadata, you'll be able to do things like create new App Store versions, set pricing and availability, edit app and version metadata, associate builds to your App Store versions, and submit those versions for review.  

Another session later this week will go more in-depth [Expanding automation with the App Store Connect API](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2020/10004/)

#### Feature Description

This can be more fleshed out later in the week when the other session becomes available to give more concrete info on what APIs will be available

#### Alternatives or Workarounds

Continue to use undocumented APIs that might break in the future

@joshdholtz 

Thank you for your draft 👍
I tried this patch and found out this is not enough because old `wait_for_build` is more than `wait_for_build_processing_to_be_complete`.

`wait_for_build` get all build candidates and compare its upload_date to find latest_build before checking processing_to_be_complete.
When the fastlane user does not specify `app_version`, this changes will break their deliver.
